findings: The current test strategy is bound to the prior R-0002 design: its acceptance IDs are AC-SET/AC-TST/AC-CI/AC-CLN rather than the current R-0001 FP-AC01..FP-AC21 criteria. A Build can therefore pass every listed selector while source coverage, complete seam proofs, realized conformance, authorized recovery, native-host journeys, many-to-many acceptance, and finalization remain untested.

The acceptance map repeats the stale R-0002 selectors and does not assign distinct failing-capable positive and negative proofs for each current journey. In particular, the real-host J1/J6 proofs, Design-to-Plan-to-Build package severance, post-interruption pickup/reconciliation, rejected-review correction, and joint multi-task acceptance have no current selector ownership or real-versus-simulated evidence rule.
decisions: Regenerate design/test-strategy.json and the Design acceptance map from FP-AC01..FP-AC21, binding every criterion to exact public-entry selectors, owned positive and negative/severed proofs, freshness inputs, controlled dependencies, and explicit real-versus-simulated provenance.

Do not admit Plan or Build on the current strategy; first replace the stale R-0002 authority and prove the strategy fingerprint, requirement identity, current candidate, and every selector all belong to the same R-0001 Design package.
